Messages.Author: Lech
Messages.Body:
It's attempt to modernize vtes without changes to existing cards.

All phases are for every player. First player (first is determined at random) can perform actions first, then impulse is passed to his prey until all players pass. Then next phase is executed.

So to sum it up:
Unlock (all players unlock their cards, then impulse move around until everyone pass)

Master (all players play master cards as impulse move around until everyone pass)

Minion (all players perform actions as impulse move around, if you pass you still get impulse in next go if anyone else perform an action, YOU CAN PLAY OOT MASTERS when impulse is under another player control)

Influence (all players have 5 transfers, influencing out vampire cost 1 transfer, rest is unchanged, performed as impulse move around until everyone pass)

Discard (all players discard their cards/play events as impulse move around until everyone pass)

Only problematic part are some cards like:
Baseball Bat -- Type: Equipment -- Cost: 1 pool
Melee weapon. Do not replace until after this action.
Strength+1 damage each strike. If the action to equip with the Baseball Bat is successful, unlock the acting minion at the end of the turn.
Sets: TR:C, HttB:PSal5

Ambrosio Luis Monçada, Plenipotentiary. Clan: Lasombra Group: 2 Capacity: 10 aus for DOM OBT POT PRE
Sabbat cardinal: Monçada cannot block. Other Methuselahs' actions targeting Monçada cost an additional pool. If Monçada is ready during your discard phase, he can unlock another ready Lasombra.
Sets: SW:U

Possible out is errating those to work when you pass impulse (wording it with during, so you can do it once per turn and ...

Eluding the Arms of Morpheus -- Type: Reaction -- Cost: 1 blood
Only usable by a locked vampire.
This vampire unlocks and attempts to block.
Sets: LotN:C/PG2/PS2, KoT:C

It definitely should make the vampire unable to act this turn, as most wakes.

It's open for discussion/criticism.

Of course it could be also coupled with modern mulligan (put any number of cards from hand aside, draw replacement card and shuffle library with mulliganed cards), and/or introduce new card type playable in minion phase not as an action, but it's sideline.

Moreover for fuck sake, why this forum don't have dark theme? My eyes burns.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
It is a lot harder to lunge in that format: you can't plan a whole turn in advance because of other player's actions, and you always start your turn with your prey fully unlocked. So while the play might feel faster, it is probably more likely to deadlock,

Cardflow management would be easier: the faster you switch between attack and defense, the easier it is to play any cards in your hand. That should be good for toolboxes. More cards should be played because it makes less sense to keep something in your hand for later in the turn rather than play it now then cycle until you get the next copy.
